{'role': 'assistant', 'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': "Full suite green (465 tests, up from 464). Working tree shows only my two intended files changed.\n\n## Summary\n\n**Root cause:** In `Chess._moves` (src/chess.ts), the pawn **single/double push** logic lacked the off-board `to & 0x88` guard that the capture path already had. For a pawn sitting on an edge rank — white pawn on rank 8 (e.g. `h8`), or black pawn on rank 1 (e.g. `h1`), the forward push computes a destination off the board (`h8` − 16 = `-9`). Because `board[-9]` is `undefined` (treated as empty), `addMove` recorded a pseudo-legal move with an out-of-bounds `to`. During legal-move filtering, `_makeMove` → `_movePiece` called `_pieceKey(to)`, which returned `undefined` from the Zobrist `PIECE_KEYS` array; `_hash ^= undefined` then throws `TypeError: Cannot mix BigInt and other types`. (Had the push been on-board, `addMove` would correctly emit promotion moves.)\n\n**Fix (minimal, style-consistent):** src/chess.ts:1578 — added `!(to & 0x88)` to the single-push guard, matching the off-board check the capture loop already uses:\n```ts\nto = from + PAWN_OFFSETS[us][0]\nif (!(to & 0x88) && !this._board[to]) {\n```\nThis makes edge-rank pawns generate zero forward moves; the double-push is nested inside so it's covered.\n\n**Files changed:**\n- `src/chess.ts` — one-line off-board guard on the pawn single push.\n- `__tests__/regression.test.ts` — new regression test `pawn on an edge rank does not generate off-board moves`, covering both the white pawn on `h8` and black pawn on `h1` (via `setTurn('b')`), asserting `moves({ square, verbose })` and full-board `moves()` return `[]`.\n\n**Verification:**\n- Bug reproduced first (failing test before the fix).\n- Regression test fails without the fix (confirmed via `git stash`), passes with it.\n- Full suite: `npm test` → 465 tests pass (was 464 baseline + 1 new)."}], 'api': 'openai-completions', 'provider': 'pod-dsv4', 'model': 'deepseek-v4-flash-0731', 'usage': {'input': 41506, 'output': 523, 'cacheRead': 0, 'cacheWrite': 0, 'totalTokens': 42029, 'cost': {'input': 0, 'output': 0, 'cacheRead': 0, 'cacheWrite': 0, 'total': 0}}, 'stopReason': 'stop', 'timestamp': 1787265729105, 'responseId': 'chatcmpl-9837cb4ae7b9dae8', 'duration': 2544.483400000012, 'ttft': 368.0572000000102, 'contextSnapshot': {'promptTokens': 41506, 'nonMessageTokens': 13936}}
